1543824507231784961.a: I've been starving for years and every few weeks hospital sends a survey asking if I have food and shelter. Every time I answer I don't have food. Nothing ever offered. State Websites say i don't qualify. Federal SNAP regs trump state. I applied and got expedited in 7 days.

1543824508607516673.a: The state will tell you things like you must complete work requirements and stupid nonsense. You can't work if you are dying from starvation. Feds say you get 90 days expedited if you have under $5k in assets. You're looking at about 10 days before you have a food card.

1543824509865758721.a: Same for healthcare. Indiana has a medicare for all pilot program. Literally anyone making less than $17k qualifies. My monthly premium is $1 and I've been billed $0 in 4 years; ~$300k in invoices, $0 owed.

1543824511103078401.a: Housing they tell me you have to had lived under a bridge for 365 days to qualify. I'm beginning to wonder if that's a lie as well. Thankfully I've not needed that so I've not looked into it.

We didn't take seriously the effects of cosmic rays on memory in computers until a voting machine in Belgium in 2003 recorded an extra 4096 votes for a candidate. The machine had no error correction. Today we use Ferromagnetic RAM, parity, force-fields, etc to avoid these errors. Tweet by @Rainmaker1973

https://x.com/Rainmaker1973/status/1543930912987119616

1543938154616573956.a: You'll notice many satellites and medical devices now have a lot of logic handled by the Texas Instruments MSP430FR series chips which are immune to bit flips like static electricity based capacitive DRAM. 1543938759011573762.a: Think about the computers in the Xray and CT labs... There's high energy particles flying around in there. Nevermind cell phones and MRIs and whatnot which also cause memory errors. Very hostile place for electronics.
